name: MusicBrainz Tagger
description: Finds tracks with no artist on MusicBrainz by their title and length, and fills in the tags and cover they are missing.
author: Jewelcase examples

guessFromTitle.title: Guess from the title
guessFromTitle.description: When MusicBrainz has no match for a title that names its artist, such as "Artist feat. Other - Song (Official Audio)", write that artist and song anyway.

covers.title: Embed covers
covers.description: Embed the matched release's front cover, from the Cover Art Archive, in files with no picture.

permissions.reason: To find tracks with no artist, and read their files' tags.

To search for recordings on musicbrainz.org, a little under once a second, inside the limit it asks clients to keep to, and to fetch covers from coverartarchive.org. Covers are served from archive.org's servers, whose names change, so it asks for any host.
To write the tags and covers it finds into your files. Without it, it only reports what it would write.
To look up tracks with no artist as they are added.
To carry on through the library each hour, and look again a month later for tracks it found no match for.
